generator: Local Pillow derivation from preserved character multiview front drawings; no new portrait generation.
processing: assets/icons/prepare-psychic-rock.py: border flood-fill from white at tolerance 38 using slice-sheet.py; alpha trim and 8% square padding; work at 960x960, add #142f50 silhouette outline with MaxFilter(13), remove white matte fringe with MinFilter(7), recolor source pixels whose maximum RGB channel is below 75 to #142f50, composite and Lanczos to 320x320, WebP q90.
poseEdit: Geodude's existing front drawing is recomposed with each arm rotated upward by 45 degrees and its masked boulder body enlarged 1.5x. This keeps both complete fists and a larger readable face at 28–48px. Crop, mask and placement coordinates are preserved in prepare-psychic-rock.py; the source is unchanged.
selection: Two portrait-sheet requests image-38907-11 and image-38907-19 failed with image-service safety rejections and produced no image. Original requests are preserved in assets/icons/source/psychic-rock-generation.json. These portraits reuse the separately completed front drawings. They are not presented as outputs of the failed requests.
purpose: Shared player portraits, lobby roster and codex form art.
